raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash fails to load on Hopper unless `--moe-backend marlin` is passed:

```
ValueError: Per-token NVFP4 activation scales are not supported by HUMMING.
```

Its NVFP4 experts always declare a per-token FC1 scheme (#64111). On SM90 the auto selection puts Humming first (#56997), and Humming runs NVFP4 experts as W4A16 there. `make_nvfp4_moe_kernel` already drops the per-token metadata for Marlin W4A16. This PR does the same for Humming when its quant config has no activation dtype.

The recipe's Hopper serve command pins `--moe-backend marlin` and already loads. Its Hopper strategy didn't pass that flag, so this PR adds it there, and the Hopper notes now say the experts run as W4A16 on Humming when no MoE backend is given. No open PR or issue covers this.

## Claims

- MiniMax-M3.1-Flash's NVFP4 experts load and run on SM90 with the default MoE backend (Humming W4A16) or an explicit `--moe-backend humming`.
- Configs that loaded before are unchanged. Marlin keeps the same condition, and Humming with quantized activations still raises.

## Validation

New test `tests/kernels/moe/test_minimax_m3_hopper_nvfp4_moe.py`, on 1x H100. It builds the experts the way M3.1 does (`ModelOptMxFp8Config` with NVFP4 MoE, `qat_activation_key=kNvfp4DynamicToken`), loads a random NVFP4 checkpoint, and compares the forward against a dequantized reference. It runs in a new H100 CI step.

| case | main + new test only | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `[humming]` | `ValueError: Per-token NVFP4 activation scales are not supported by HUMMING.` | passed |
| `[marlin]` | passed | passed |

Real weights through `LLM` on 1x H200: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash cut to its first 4 layers (3 dense, 1 NVFP4 MoE; `hf_overrides={"text_config": {"num_hidden_layers": 4}}`, only the 3 shards holding them on disk), TP1, the recipe's Hopper flags, greedy 16 tokens with top-5 logprobs on 4 prompts. Same nightly `2b009fc` with main `564ac0d`'s Python on top, the fixed run plus this PR:

| source | MoE backend | load | greedy tokens vs Marlin | max logprob diff on those tokens |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main | auto, picks HUMMING | fails with the error above | - | - |
| this PR | auto, picks HUMMING | ok | 64 / 64 same | 0.061 |
| this PR | `--moe-backend marlin` | ok | reference | - |

A 4-layer cut doesn't produce text (both arms repeat one token), so this run checks real-weight loading and that the two W4A16 backends agree.

Decode on the full layer count, 1x H200 with the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash config cut to one TP8 rank's shapes (8 q heads, 1 KV and index head, FFN widths and vocab / 8, all 60 layers and 128 experts, dummy weights) and the recipe's Hopper flags. Both rows run nightly `2b009fc` with main `564ac0d`'s Python on top, the second one plus this PR:

| source | MoE backend | load | decode C1 | decode C8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main | auto, picks HUMMING | fails with the error above | - | - |
| this PR | auto, picks HUMMING | ok | 5.33 ms/token | 7.93 ms/token |
| this PR | `--moe-backend marlin` | ok | 5.18 ms/token | 6.74 ms/token |

Decode is 4K-token prompts, 192 output tokens, greedy. Dummy weights make the outputs meaningless, so these runs only show that the model loads and decodes on each backend.

I haven't run the full checkpoint on Hopper (the recipe uses 8x H200), so there is no accuracy eval for M3.1 here. CI has no small M3.1 checkpoint for an `LLM`-level test, so the CI test works at the experts level and the 4-layer real-weight run above is local.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
pytest -v tests/kernels/moe/test_minimax_m3_hopper_nvfp4_moe.py
```

```python
# Real weights, first 4 layers (a local dir with the 3 shards and an index of just them)
LLM(model=local_dir, hf_overrides={"text_config": {"num_hidden_layers": 4}}, language_model_only=True,
    block_size=128, disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=True, kv_cache_dtype="fp8",
    attention_config={"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}, compilation_config={"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"},
    max_model_len=4096)  # + moe_backend="marlin" for the reference arm

# All 60 layers, one TP8 rank's shapes, dummy weights
LLM(model="MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash", load_format="dummy", language_model_only=True,
    hf_overrides={"text_config": {"num_attention_heads": 8, "num_key_value_heads": 1,
        "intermediate_size": 384, "dense_intermediate_size": 1536, "shared_intermediate_size": 384,
        "vocab_size": 25008, "sparse_attention_config": {..., "sparse_num_index_heads": 1}}},
    block_size=128, disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=True, kv_cache_dtype="fp8",
    attention_config={"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}, compilation_config={"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"},
    max_model_len=5120)
```

</details>

## Details

- `ModelOptMxFp8Config` builds M3.1's experts with the model's `qat_activation_key` (`kNvfp4DynamicToken`) on every platform, so `per_token_activation` is set on Hopper too.
- Humming's quant config has `quant_dtype is None` when it runs A16. For Marlin's NVFP4 config that is the same check as `use_nvfp4_w4a16`.
- With the metadata dropped, the experts take the same Humming W4A16 path other NVFP4 checkpoints use on SM90.
- The ModelOpt NVFP4 `nvfp4_per_token` override doesn't reach this code on Hopper. `ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE` rejects any backend other than FlashInfer TRTLLM first.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used. I reviewed the change and ran the tests above.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

</details>

@@ -1602,7 +1604,8 @@ guide: |
   ```
 
   - Hopper has no FP4 tensor cores: the KV cache and the indexer K cache use
-    FP8, and the NVFP4 experts run on the Marlin MoE kernel.
+    FP8, and the NVFP4 experts run as W4A16 on the Marlin MoE kernel. Without
+    `--moe-backend`, they run as W4A16 on Humming.
   - `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video": 0}'` turns off video inputs; images
     still work.
   - DSpark speculative decoding is not enabled on Hopper.

@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Hopper coverage for MiniMax-M3.1's NVFP4 experts, which declare a per-token
+FC1 scheme that the SM90 W4A16 backends do not use."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.kernels.utils import torch_experts
+from vllm.config import (
+    KernelConfig,
+    ParallelConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoEFactory, fused_topk
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.marlin_moe import MarlinExperts
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptMxFp8Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.marlin_utils_fp4 import (
+    is_fp4_marlin_supported,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.nvfp4_emulation_utils import (
+    dequantize_to_dtype,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+    kNvfp4DynamicToken,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import has_humming
+
+if not (current_platform.is_device_capability_family(90) and is_fp4_marlin_supported()):
+    pytest.skip("Requires an SM90 GPU with Marlin", allow_module_level=True)
+
+E, N, K, TOPK, M = 8, 256, 512, 2, 8
+
+
+def _checkpoint() -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+
+    def packed(*shape):
+        return torch.randint(
+            0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+
+    def scales(*shape):
+        return torch.ones(*shape, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda")
+
+    # One global scale per expert, shared by w1 and w3 as in the checkpoint.
+    w13_global = torch.rand(E, 1, device="cuda", generator=g) * 50 + 50
+    return {
+        "w13_weight_packed": packed(E, 2 * N, K // 2),
+        "w13_weight_scale": scales(E, 2 * N, K // 16),
+        "w13_weight_global_scale": w13_global.expand(E, 2).contiguous(),
+        "w13_input_global_scale": torch.ones(E, 2, device="cuda"),
+        "w2_weight_packed": packed(E, K, N // 2),
+        "w2_weight_scale": scales(E, K, N // 16),
+        "w2_weight_global_scale": torch.rand(E, device="cuda", generator=g) * 50 + 50,
+        "w2_input_global_scale": torch.ones(E, device="cuda"),
+    }
+
+
+def _dequant(q, scale, global_scale):
+    return dequantize_to_dtype(
+        q, scale, 1.0 / global_scale, torch.bfloat16, block_size=16, swizzle=False
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("moe_backend", ["humming", "marlin"])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_per_token_nvfp4_experts_run_as_w4a16(
+    dist_init, workspace_init, moe_backend
+) -> None:
+    if moe_backend == "humming" and not has_humming():
+        pytest.skip("Requires humming")
+    ckpt = _checkpoint()
+    quant_config = ModelOptMxFp8Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "mxfp8",
+            "moe_quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "moe_quant_format": "nvfp4-pack-quantized",
+            "group_size": 16,
+            "ignored_layers": [],
+        }
+    )
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        kernel_config=KernelConfig(moe_backend=moe_backend),
+    )
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        runner = FusedMoEFactory(
+            num_experts=E,
+            top_k=TOPK,
+            hidden_size=K,
+            intermediate_size=N,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix="model.layers.0.block_sparse_moe.experts",
+            qat_activation_key=kNvfp4DynamicToken,
+        )
+    runner.cuda()
+    routed = runner.routed_experts
+    for name, tensor in ckpt.items():
+        getattr(routed, name).data.copy_(tensor)
+    routed.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(routed)
+    moe_kernel = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel
+    assert moe_kernel is not None
+    experts = moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    assert (type(experts) is MarlinExperts) == (moe_backend == "marlin")
+
+    x = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") / 10
+    logits = torch.randn(M, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+        out = runner.forward(hidden_states=x, router_logits=logits)
+
+    w13 = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    for shard, rows in ((0, slice(0, N)), (1, slice(N, 2 * N))):
+        w13[:, rows] = _dequant(
+            ckpt["w13_weight_packed"][:, rows],
+            ckpt["w13_weight_scale"][:, rows],
+            ckpt["w13_weight_global_scale"][:, shard],
+        )
+    w2 = _dequant(
+        ckpt["w2_weight_packed"],
+        ckpt["w2_weight_scale"],
+        ckpt["w2_weight_global_scale"],
+    )
+    topk_weights, topk_ids, _ = fused_topk(x, logits, TOPK, renormalize=True)
+    expected = torch_experts(x, w13, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids).float()
+    assert (out.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm() < 2e-2

@@ -638,8 +638,12 @@ def make_nvfp4_moe_kernel(
     routing_tables: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
     per_token_activation: bool = False,
 ) -> mk.FusedMoEKernel:
-    # Marlin consumes A16 and must not receive per-token A4 metadata.
-    if backend == NvFp4MoeBackend.MARLIN and moe_quant_config.use_nvfp4_w4a16:
+    # Marlin, and Humming without activation quantization (SM90), consume A16
+    # and must not receive per-token A4 metadata.
+    if (
+        backend in (NvFp4MoeBackend.MARLIN, NvFp4MoeBackend.HUMMING)
+        and moe_quant_config.quant_dtype is None
+    ):
         per_token_activation = False
 
     # Create Prepare/Finalize.
